full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned ink drawing shows a crowded café interior centered on a mustached man seated at a long pale table. He occupies the left foreground, wearing a heavy black jacket over a high white collar, with one arm resting along the table edge. His dark hair is combed back, his thick mustache and short beard are carefully crosshatched, and he looks toward the right with a tired, intent expression. The tabletop extends diagonally from the lower-left foreground toward the upper-right center, creating a bright wedge between the man and the other patrons. Near its far end, a small clear glass stands beside a younger dark-haired person who leans forward and turns toward the right. A larger bearded man bends over this seated figure from behind. Across the upper half, many people in dark hats and coats fill the room in overlapping rows; some face away, others appear in half profile. Framed pictures, vertical wall divisions, and a doorway-like opening show faintly behind the dense crowd. A partial head enters at the lower left, emphasizing the close, packed viewpoint. The light is diffuse and indoor-soft, leaving the tabletop almost white while dark coats collect thick shadow through repeated pen strokes. Fine crosshatching shapes faces and sleeves; looser lines and erased-looking gaps keep the background active without making every figure equally sharp. The overall composition pulls the eye along the pale diagonal table into a crowded social room, balancing intimate observation against restless bustle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐调墨线画呈现拥挤的咖啡馆室内，焦点是一名坐在长长浅色桌边、留胡子的男子。他占据左侧前景，厚重黑外套内露出高白领，一只手臂沿桌边放着。深发向后梳，浓密胡子与短须由细密交叉线塑造；他带着疲惫而专注的神情望向右侧。桌面从左下前景斜伸到右上方中部，在男子与其他客人之间形成明亮的楔形。桌子远端附近有一只小透明杯，一名较年轻的黑发人物在旁向前倾身、转向右边。一名更高大、留胡子的男子从后方俯向这位坐着的人。上半部许多戴深色帽子、穿深色外套的人前后重叠地填满房间；有人背对观者，也有人露出半侧脸。画框、竖向墙面分隔和类似门洞的开口在密集人群后隐约出现。下左缘还有一颗被裁去一部分的头，强调近距离而拥挤的视点。室内光漫射且柔和，使桌面近乎白色，深外套则通过重复钢笔线积成浓影。细交叉排线塑造脸与衣袖；更松散的线和仿佛擦去的空隙让背景活跃，却不使每个人同样清楚。整体构图沿浅色斜桌面引导视线进入拥挤的社交空间，在亲密观察与躁动人群之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Sepia ink drawing uses fine crosshatching, close contour work, and broad unmarked paper to organize crowded figures. Charcoal-brown coats and hats form dense overlapping masses, while pale wedge-shaped spaces keep the eye moving through them. Faces receive selective delicate lines; farther forms loosen into quick strokes and broken outlines. Interior light is soft and diffuse, represented through reserved paper rather than white paint or bright reflection. A strong diagonal surface leads into stacked shallow depth, and partial crops at the edges reinforce the sense of bustle. The overall effect is observational, textured, and lively without relying on strong color.
style_prompt_zh: 棕褐墨线画利用细密交叉排线、贴近的轮廓描写和大片未着墨的纸面组织拥挤形体。炭褐色衣帽形成密集遮叠色团，浅色楔形空隙则让视线穿过其中。面部获得选择性的细线，较远形体松开成快速笔触和断裂轮廓。室内光柔和漫射，借留白纸面表现，而不依靠白颜料或明亮反光。强烈斜向平面引入层层浅纵深，边缘被裁去一部分的形体加强忙碌感。整体效果具有观察性、肌理丰富且活跃，无需强烈色彩。
theme_en: A mustached man seated at a café table amid a crowded interior
theme_zh: 一名留胡子的男子坐在咖啡馆桌边，周围室内人群拥挤
name: Theophile Steinlen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
